answer: Deterministic FPGA outputs bitwise equal to architecture-exact bit-true model for identical input and initial state; reproduce rounding, saturation, overflow, width and operation order; stage-specific floating-reference error tolerances remain OPEN.
Independent stationary clutter suppression and moving-target MTI frequency response tests; finite-precision suppression threshold OPEN.
Pfa goal 1e-3 per valid CUT on defined statistical ensemble; actual CFAR type, training/guard/edges, confidence, effective trial count and Pd criterion OPEN.
No physical FPGA resource overuse, mandatory successful place-route/STA; uniform 90% cap NOT approved; resource-dependent headroom OPEN.
USB-UART packets carry length, sequence ID, CRC-32; detect malformed, corrupted, truncated, duplicate, out-of-order frames and controlled recovery; detail CRC variant, retries, baud OPEN.

Accept integer-sample range estimation with documented matched-filter delay compensation, report error in range-bin units and metres. Distinguish target localization accuracy from two-target range resolution (theory about 600m). Sub-sample interpolation not required. Valid range cells and error tolerance depend on finalized matched filter.

Test FFT bin-centered radial velocities and separate off-bin velocities including approved -3, +1.5, +5 m/s target velocities. Measure signed bin error, signed radial-velocity error (m/s), and spectral leakage. Doppler-bin order and phase conventions consistent with positive approaching. Sub-bin interpolation not required.

Use complex Gaussian noise-only, zero-target, zero-clutter baseline for initial false-alarm assessment; evaluate statistical dependency after matched filter, MTI and FFT when estimating uncertainty. Separately evaluate stationary, correlated and heterogeneous clutter. Design Pfa=1e-3 per valid CUT applies to noise-only baseline, not untested clutter ensembles.

topic: two-level target list validation and unique association
answer: Separate bit-exact FPGA vs bit-true clustering/target-list check and radar performance against target truth (true/missed/false detections and errors in range, velocity, power). Establish deterministic one-to-one association so one detection cannot match multiple truth objects. Do not require all three targets detected at all SNR levels; statistical acceptance depends on scenario and trials.

Range localization acceptance: for a single target with no noise/clutter, sample-grid-aligned delay and inside valid range, the compensated range-peak index must exactly equal expected index. At 20 dB input SNR, <=1 sample (150m) is a DESIGN TARGET only; statistical pass criterion pending reference-model evaluation. No subsample estimation required.

Dominant isolated target with identifiable spectral peak: nearest-bin velocity error <=0.234375 m/s, half of 0.46875m/s Doppler-bin spacing. Independently test on-bin/off-bin, near two-bin boundaries, MTI response and leakage; positive radial velocity approaching.

Evaluate baseline Pfa=1e-3 per valid CUT using independent seeded CPIs with 95 percent confidence interval. Treat correlated range-Doppler CUTs with appropriate uncertainty estimation. Decide quantitative acceptance tolerance prior to test; do not assume all CUTs independent.

Initial DESIGN TARGET Pd >=0.9 for single target without clutter at input SNR 20 dB, subject to checking reference model, SNR contract, CFAR and trial conditions. Measure/report Pd at SNR 0 and 10 dB with no minimum approved.

Use deterministic global minimum-cost one-to-one detection-to-truth assignment based on normalized range and velocity errors. Before tests freeze normalization, match gating and tie-breaking; each detection and truth may participate in at most one true assignment.
Complex baseband centered LFM frequency sweep nominal -125 to +125 kHz over 16us, rectangular 16-sample time window at 1MS/s. Phase, sample convention and MF taps specified in reference.
Isolated target received power averaged on its own active echo samples. Circular complex noise E|w|²=sigma², independent real/imag variances sigma²/2. SNR before DSP.
2D CA-CFAR required in phase one. OS-CFAR optional only.
Rectangular Doppler FFT window required baseline, measure MTI effect, off-bin leakage; Hann optional and not mandatory on FPGA.
Noise-only baseline Pfa design target 1e-3 per valid CUT, one-sided 95% upper CI <=1.5e-3, using declared correlation-aware method and independently seeded CPI experiments.
No-clutter plus SCR=+10dB and -10dB at receiver input based on target echo power divided by clutter power over specified region.
Initial 128-sample receive window includes all 16 samples of echo. Valid matched-filter output and CFAR CUT subsets defined separately.
Variable-length target list has count and record IDs; detect and explicitly report overflow; never silently drop records. Buffer capacity and overflow selection algorithm deferred to architecture.
Full output of each FPGA processing function available for independent reference comparison, possibly via deterministic rerun and staged UART dump; simultaneous retention not mandatory.
Reported target power is linear selected range-Doppler cell power with explicit scale, numeric format and extraction point. Input echo power calibration/de-embedding not mandatory.
